messages:
alex: hey team, first week and hitting a weird CI failure. Buildkite step tries to repo_dispatch GH Actions but gets 403 Forbidden. snippet: 

```
POST https://api.github.com/repos/redwood-inference/metrics/actions/workflows/ci.yml/dispatches 403 Forbidden - resource not accessible by integration
```

alex: i can view the repo in GH and the pipeline in Buildkite. anyone know whether this is a repo-level install issue or the token scope? @sara @jared

sara: welcome! :wave: usually either the Buildkite GitHub App isn't installed on that specific repo, or the app doesn't have the "workflows" permission. also check if the org enforces SSO — tokens from users not SSO'd can be blocked.

jared: quick checklist: 1) confirm Buildkite app is installed for repo (org settings -> installations). 2) confirm Buildkite integration is set to use the org app (not a personal PAT). 3) if using a user token, ensure repo and workflow scopes. i can check install now.

sec-bot: security note: if your account hasn't completed SSO or 2FA we block repo dispatch calls for org resources. alex, is your account SSO-enrolled?

alex: i completed 2FA but not SSO yet, doing that now. thanks, will try after SSO.

jared: i also see the Buildkite app in "selected repos" mode and metrics isn't included. i've added it — should propagate in ~30s. re-run once SSO is done.

ci-bot: buildkite/job/6622 re-run requested by jared

alex: reran — repo_dispatch returned 204 and GH Actions queued. perfect, thanks! :raised_hands:

sara: onboarding action: please add a one-line note to infra/permissions.md about SSO + app install for repo_dispatch, and move the curl into scripts/dispatch.sh that logs response codes. helps future new hires.

alex: on it, will open the PR and tag you. thanks everyone!
